title: bring forth/spring up. This sweet prayer is a blessing the Lord pronounces on us, that righteousness, like plants, will spring forth on the earth. As Creator, the Lord implies, he has the power to bring about such a blessing (26:19). With our agency, we can choose to participate in this blessing. This passage may also refer to the coming of the Messiah, whose name is Son of Righteousness (3 Ne. 25:2).
author: Tina M. Peterson
